title: Luke's theory: Old Kingdom pharaohs were never buried in their pyramids, but in the south near Abydos

tellings.quote: I think he knew something that's invisible to us today that the pharaohs of the old kingdom are never buried in their pyramids and their tombs are down south.

plain: The pharaohs of Egypt's Old Kingdom, the age of the great pyramids at Giza, were never buried in their pyramids, says a researcher named Luke Caverns. He tells Michels their real tombs are "down south," near the ancient site of Abydos. He says the later pharaoh Amenemhat III "knew something that's invisible to us today," and if he is right the pyramids were built for some purpose other than tombs.
